description: Rename a page, change its address label (slug), or switch private/public. Also sets its one-line description and the project it is filed under.

description.description: Optional one-line description shown in the user's pages list. An empty string clears it.

project.description: Optional project to file the page under, by name or id from list_projects, e.g. "Q4 proposal". A new name starts that project. An empty string takes the page out of its project.

siteId.description: Page id (siteId) returned by a publish tool or list_pages.

slug.description: New address label, 3-40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

visibility.description: private (invitation-only, default) or public (anyone with the link).

name: update_page

shares.description: Sends, each with recipients and when they opened the page.

title: Update page
